Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision that occurred while the patient was turning
left and was struck from the side. Initial evaluation documented pain, swelling, and
reduced grip strength in the left wrist. Imaging and examination findings clearly
confirm a fracture of the distal radius. Six visits were completed over the course of
care, including immobilization, follow-up imaging, and a structured rehabilitation
program. Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved,
with pain and range of motion steadily recovering. The patient was also treated for the
same body area within the last two years, and that prior condition adds to the current
complaints, so some of the symptoms reported today may reflect that earlier history.
It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash, and causation remains
under review pending additional records. Billing records show no repeated charges for
the same services. The patient is being discharged from active care with a plan for
home exercises and as-needed follow-up.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
